outline:
本課程介紹數據分析的基本及進階的概念和技術，以及如何將它們應用於大規模數據集。主要是在回顧描述性統計，概率分佈，推理統計（估計和假設檢驗）和回歸分析，機器學習技術(PCA、ICA)、判別分析、聚類分析、SVM、隨機森林、人工神經網絡、DTW、EMD。此外，本課程將使用流行且功能強大的數據分析語言(即R)來解決許多實際問題。
This course covers the basic and advanced concepts and techniques of data analytics and how to apply them to large-scale data sets. Mainly, after a review of descriptive statistics, probability distributions, inferential statistics (estimation and hypothesis tests), and regression analysis, various machine learning techniques such as PCA, ICA, discriminant analysis, cluster analysis, SVM, random forest, artificial neural network, DTW, EMD will be dealt. Also, this course will show you how to use the popular and powerful data analysis language, that is, R, to solve many practical problems based on use cases extracted from real domains.
schedule:
Tentative schedule
Week 1	Introduction to big data analytics: big data overview, concepts of supervised and unsupervised learning, and data pre-processing
Week 2	Basic statistics: Random variables, mean, median, standard deviation, variance, correlation, covariance
Week 3	Regression: Simple and multiple linear regression
Week 4	Dimension reduction techniques (Part I): Principal component analysis (PCA)
Week 5	Dimension reduction techniques (Part I): Independent component analysis (ICA)
Week 6	Classification (Part I): Logistic regression, k-NN, decision trees, SVM
Week 7	Classification (Part II): Logistic regression, k-NN, decision trees, SVM
Week 8	Classification (Part III): Logistic regression, k-NN, decision trees, SVM
Week 9	Midterm Exam (In-Class, 1 Cheat Sheet, Calculator)
Week 10	Clustering (Part I): Hierarchical clustering
Week 11	Clustering (Part II): Nonhierarchical clustering
Week 12	Ensemble methods: bagging, random forests, boosting
Week 13	Ensemble methods: bagging, random forests, boosting
Week 14	Artificial neural network (ANN)
Week 15	Artificial neural network (ANN)
Week 16	Dynamic time warping (DTW)
Week 17	Empirical mode decomposition (EMD)
Week 18	Final Exam (In-Class, 1 Cheat sheet, Calculator)
